Each position record states its method, uncertainty and frames. S5/S6 add radar objective-indicator icons told apart from creature pips by the client radar code (client/ui/radarwindow.pyo HandleUpdateObjectiveIndicators, _GetEntityRadarType), third-person camera-ray triangulation for the bomb, the nameplate range readout for the outpost Thrax, inferred reinforcement bearings on the pad, the original damaged-pad map anchor for the exit, and the Alia Das arrival from the wilderness radar texture with Y from the derived adv_foreas_concordia_wilderness navmesh.
